kpis.description_fr: Eylea (AMD ophthalmologie) USA + Eylea HD (HD = higher dose, lancement 2023). Pression biosimilaires + Vabysmo (Roche). Switch Eylea→Eylea HD en cours.
kpis.description_en: Eylea (AMD ophthalmology) USA + Eylea HD (HD = higher dose, 2023 launch). Pressure from biosimilars + Vabysmo (Roche). Eylea→Eylea HD switch underway.

kpis.description_fr: Dupixent = IL-4/IL-13 antibody (atopic dermatitis + asthma + COPD + eosinophilic esophagitis + 7e indication 2024). Mega-blockbuster. Co-développé Sanofi (50/50). Regeneron book ~38 % marge.
kpis.description_en: Dupixent = IL-4/IL-13 antibody (atopic dermatitis + asthma + COPD + eosinophilic esophagitis + 7th indication 2024). Mega-blockbuster. Co-developed with Sanofi (50/50). Regeneron books ~38% margin.

kpis.description_fr: Libtayo = checkpoint inhibitor PD-1 (rare cancers + recently NSCLC). Croissance forte vs Keytruda dominance. Acquisition rights from Sanofi 2022.
kpis.description_en: Libtayo = checkpoint inhibitor PD-1 (rare cancers + recently NSCLC). Strong growth despite Keytruda dominance. Sanofi rights acquired 2022.

kpis.description_fr: ~35 trials Phase 3 actifs. Pipeline diversifié : ITEPEKIMAB (COPD), Linvoseltamab (myeloma), Odronextamab (NHL), Trap-Eye (Eylea HD ext), Garetosmab.
kpis.description_en: ~35 Phase 3 trials active. Diversified pipeline: ITEPEKIMAB (COPD), Linvoseltamab (myeloma), Odronextamab (NHL), Trap-Eye (Eylea HD ext), Garetosmab.

kpis.description_fr: Collaboration Sanofi cumulée Dupixent + Kevzara + Praluent. Croissance forte avec Dupixent. Modèle royalties très profitable.
kpis.description_en: Sanofi collaboration cumulative Dupixent + Kevzara + Praluent. Strong growth with Dupixent. Highly profitable royalty model.
